item.title: Version 0.18.0
item.description:
## 0.18.0 — 2026-10-09
### Features
- **automation:** app intents and whisk:// links - **automation:** run a tool's action by id, and read the last texts - **tools:** declare what can be asked of a tool from outside Whisk - **dictate:** start and stop a dictation without toggling - **dictate:** say which model cleans up while a command-line provider is selected - **llm:** use a Claude or ChatGPT subscription through Claude Code or Codex - **llm:** run a command-line tool and find it without a shell PATH
### Bug Fixes
- **automation:** make the Alfred script work with either way of passing input - **automation:** show the tool's reason in Shortcuts, and tidy links and docs - **dictate:** ask again from a pre-alert left on screen, and say when busy - **meetings:** announce a recording that automation could not start - **automation:** open links in the background from Alfred - **automation:** forgive a trailing space and keep the main window out of links - **automation:** fail when a recording or dictation did not start - **llm:** keep Codex from taking the stdin marker for an image, and a chosen tool that is gone stays missing - **llm:** a tool that exits on SIGTERM still timed out, and a cancelled check offers Check Again - **settings:** show a chosen tool's location so a wrong choice can be changed - **llm:** take Codex's command, browser and network tools away, and read only its own errors - **llm:** a command that ends early, lingers or ignores SIGTERM cannot hang or end Whisk - **llm:** keep the command-line mock off the main actor

item.title: Version 0.17.0
item.description:

### Bug Fixes
- **meetings:** hold the countdown through a moment that may be a call - **meetings:** hold the countdown for a call that is starting - **meetings:** keep the offer to stop reachable and steady after review - **analytics:** don't log a report destination while sharing is off - **analytics:** send nothing at all while sharing is off

item.title: Version 0.14.0

### Bug Fixes
- **build:** leave the app in the disk image free of Finder flags - **onboarding:** open in front of other apps on first launch - **settings:** point Screen Recording help at General - **main:** keep an open History editor when Settings is chosen - **history:** show empty lists without the tool's room - **meetings:** start sentences and new speakers with a capital

item.title: Version 0.13.0
item.description:
## 0.13.0 — 2026-10-07
### Features
- **meetings:** hide the Transcript panel from the menu too - **meetings:** start a new group once a speaker has gone on a minute - **history:** edit a meeting's transcript - **meetings:** show the live transcript in a panel and in History - **suite:** list what else a tool can do under its menu item - **meetings:** show a live transcript that follows the newest line - **meetings:** keep a live transcript beside every recording - **meetings:** transcribe both tracks live with SpeechAnalyzer - **meetings:** hand each track to a live sink as it is written - **schedule:** open the event read without AI when the model fails - **schedule:** read an event from recognized text without a model - **onboarding:** offer Open at login beside Done - **settings:** add Open at login to General - **settings:** add a launch-at-login service and manager - **llm:** offer OpenRouter as a provider in the AI tab - **llm:** add an OpenRouter service and model catalog
### Bug Fixes
- **history:** copy what was heard live of a failed meeting - **main:** drop a Show in History request once it is handled - **meetings:** say nothing was transcribed rather than nothing was said - **history:** ask before Try Again replaces an edited transcript - **history:** edit what was heard live on a failed meeting - **meetings:** say the live transcript was not ready, not that nothing was said - **meetings:** never let the live transcript hold up the end of a meeting - **history:** show what was heard live when a meeting could not be transcribed - **meetings:** keep why there was no live transcript once a meeting ends - **meetings:** end a live transcript that stops, or cannot finish in time - **meetings:** show a final line's own text, not what it was before - **schedule:** count a date as passed once its time has, not its day - **settings:** let a cancelled OpenAI model load leave the next one alone - **settings:** keep a saved OpenRouter model listed once it leaves Popular - **settings:** reload the models when an API key is replaced - **llm:** follow OpenRouter's catalog pages only on its own host - **schedule:** read the first date still to come without a model - **schedule:** address review of the fallback - **settings:** title-case the Open at login alert and test the status mapping - **settings:** follow the HIG in the Open at login alert - **settings:** decide Open at login from the current status - **settings:** report a refused Open at login only where it was asked - **settings:** keep the screenshot preference when switching to an unknown model - **llm:** follow later pages of OpenRouter's model catalog - **settings:** judge the saved OpenRouter model only by the real catalog - **llm:** don't take a reply that ended in an error for the answer - **settings:** keep the saved OpenRouter model while the list loads - **llm:** keep the message of an error sent inside a 200 reply - **llm:** keep OpenRouter's latest aliases in the model list - **llm:** read event JSON wrapped in a code fence

item.title: Version 0.10.0
item.description:
## 0.10.0 — 2026-09-28
### Features
- **meetings:** offer to record when a call starts - **meetings:** record from the menu and read the meeting in History - **meetings:** transcribe a recording with Apple's engine or OpenAI - **meetings:** put both sides of a meeting into one transcript - **meetings:** record a meeting and watch over the capture - **meetings:** capture what this Mac plays - **meetings:** write a track as crash-safe AAC on a shared clock - **transcribe:** dictate with Parakeet - **transcribe:** add speech engines that work on recordings - **updater:** check for updates with Sparkle - **history:** keep app data in a folder named after the bundle - **llm:** replace Ollama with Apple Intelligence as the default provider
### Bug Fixes
- **meetings:** offer a call again when it goes on after a mute - **meetings:** notice a call however far apart the looks are - **meetings:** offer a call once, and say when recording it fails - **meetings:** remove nothing while History cannot be trusted - **meetings:** keep the folder of a recording that is being started - **meetings:** keep a recording and its transcript through what goes wrong - **transcribe:** clean up after a cancelled download, whoever started it - **transcribe:** make sharing a download and a loaded model safe - **transcribe:** show real download progress and unload the model - **transcribe:** read the OpenAI account on the main actor - **release:** say what a failed run knows and no more - **release:** make the feed script executable and harden the job - **updater:** capture the service weakly in the main actor hop - **updater:** offer a background update in the menu - **llm:** cap and time out Apple Intelligence event extraction - **llm:** list the coming two weeks so weekdays resolve correctly - **llm:** leave the screenshot setting alone while OpenAI is not in use - **llm:** keep OpenAI for installs that predate the provider setting - **llm:** address review of the Apple Intelligence service
